results.summary: NVDA holds ~75-81% AI accelerator market share. AMD grew to only 7% (up 0.8% in Q3 2025). Intel gaining in AI inference via Xeon/Gaudi; Intel stock doubled in past year ($99.62). Biggest threat: custom silicon — Anthropic purchasing 1M Google TPUs, OpenAI/Meta/Amazon deploying AMD and Broadcom ASICs. Blackwell Ultra reportedly 'two generations ahead' of competition. Analysts note NVDA's software moat (CUDA ecosystem) as primary competitive barrier.
